balls.text: another slower ball, AB is on a knee, but is early into the shot, and drives with an open face, but can't beat the sweeper-cover, so one it will be
and Bala gets Tiwary with a slower one this time, scratchy innings this has been. Under 100ks, and Tiwary gets more height and less distance in his flick and holes out to Flintoff at square-leg fence
even Tiwary looks for the scoop, but this is sharp, and outside off, and he looks to open the face and misses
AB looks for the paddle this time, it is too full for it, but he makes contact and clearsa short fine easily, but doesn't get four
Tiwary looks to make room, trying for a single, mishits, ball goes nowhere, is inside the popping crease, but AB runs through and makes it easily
hit into the leg side, AB wants two but doesn't chance Hayden's arm
there it is, the first hundred of this IPL, full on the pads, and flicked away, what's more, he keeps the strike
and AB has got more, Flintoff tries a bouncer, sits up rib-high, and AB pulls it from front foot, over the short suqare-leg boundary, one run to go to hundred
into the nineties with a lovely cover-drive, this is a half-volley and crashed though extra cover
low fulltoss, almost a yorker, and he gets down to a knee again, and clears midwicket again, a yorker slog-swept for four, that is something
you don't slog-sweep balls at 136ks, but you are not AB either, and he gets under it and clears the midwicket boundary by a long way
fulltoss, low, fast, into the pads, and Tiwary plays straight to Hayden at midwicket and goes for single, would have been a goner had Hayden hit
who says Hayden is 37-and-a-half? AB had placed this half-volley perfectly between long-on and midwicket, but Hayden runs around from midwicket, makes a tumbling save, collects cleanly and saves tw0
and misses out, this was short, at ideal pace to be cut over point, but AB had committed to front foot, and couldn't manage the cut shot
he saw the slower ball even before Gony had thought of bowling it, waited for it, and monstrously lofted it over long-on, he could get a hundred here folks
slower ball, on the pads, and he falls over while playing it into the on side for one
outside off, and Tiwary moves across, too far, and ends up defending
and Tiwary goes midwicket this time,and gets a four finally
there is no justice in this world, Albie. perfect yorker, all AB can do is play it into the ground, whereupon the ball lobs over Morkel, and AB gets two
Tiwary is early intro the attempted drive again, and the bat handle turns and he gets a single to long-on
another dot ball for Tiwary, slower ball, wide outside off, and Tiwary gets on a knee to drive, but finds Raina at cover
into the pads, and an easy single to long-on
He is a sucker for punishemnt, is Morkel, another fulltoss, AB goes midwicket again, but higher, and for a six. is he looking at 200?
and Morkel is being tormented more by his compatriot. He bowls a fulltoss, and smacked over midwicket. AB is cashing in remorselessly
and AB keeps the strike, via a single into the covers

Morkel will be sursing himself, a peach of a shot, short, on the stumps, he stands tall, and pulls it flatly between midwicket and long-on, and Morkel, who dropped him earlier this over, has no chance this time
slower ball, on the pads, and Ab turns it to just to left of Parthiv at short fine, and they take a quick two; they seem to have picked Parthiv as their slow fielder
banged into the body again, and Tiwary this time manages to get some bat to it and takes a single to short fine
and AB enjoys the good luck for longer, lofted straight to Morkel at long-on boundary, and Morkel drops an absolute sitter
and almsot gets AB, who steps down, and top-edges it over the keeper and it bounces before the thirdman, and gets to his fifty
and Tiwary is not finding it easy, Flintoff keeps his inside the crease, and he can't force this bouncer for runs either. Three dots
short into the body again, Tiwary gets inside the line, but can't turn it to fine leg as he intends to
Flintoff gets away with this one, tries a bouncer, it passes the stumps outside leg, and then swings to end up in line, and it's not called a wide
good comeback, a perfect yorker, and only a single to fine leg
what timing, good length, on the stumps, and AB just frees his arms, sweetly, and clears the long-on fielder, the first hit to boundary since 9.3 overs
full, and outside off, and driven to left of sweeper-cover

and he gets his Ranji captain, luckily, though, this was a poor delivery, full and on the pads, Karthik connected but couldn't get enough power. And what a cool catch from Flintoff yards inside the square-leg fence, he moved to his right, and just about got his fingers under it
and Karthik walks across, trying the scoop again, but is beaten by the slower one, he was just saved from an LBW because he has moved far too across
slower ball, 99ks, but down the leg, Karthik thought of a scoop, but this was too slow
almost a yorker, and driven back to the bowler
misses out, angling into the pads, and AB just misses out on it, getting just a leg bye
on the pads, and flicked away to between square leg and midwicket for an easy two
this should have been wide, but Karthik throws his arms at it, cutting powerfully, straight to sweeper-cover
fulltoss, a little higher than what the batsmen smack their lips at, and Karthik can't get the timing right on this one, playing it straight to mid-off, and rushing through for a quick single
angling in, fullish, and played straight to long-on
swing and a miss, it was there for the drive, just outside off, fullish, and AB looks to hit through the line, but misses completely
widish, but not short enough, Karthik still cuts, and top-edges it to third man
full, almost a yorker, and Karthik can't beat mid-off
bowls a length ball, outside off, and AB slap-drives it to sweeper-cover
looks to sweep, doesn't read the doosra, but changes the shot midway to open the face towards point for another single. They are milking Murali
full, around off, turning in, and Karthik turns his around front pad for an easy single
on the off, flighted, and defended into the covers for a single
two again, this was on the pads, and AB turns it to between sqaure leg and midwicket
steps down and chips it over midwicket, good placement again, and an easy two
Murali starts with a topspinner, AB opens the face towards point, and sees a slow Parthiv at short third, and runs a quick two, smart running
on the stumps, good length, and AB just drops it to off the pitch and runs for what turns out to be an easy single
length delivery, outside off, and Karthik opens the face again, beats the flying slip, and gets a single
short again, smart batting from Karthik, who moves across to get inside the line, and drops it with soft hands into the on side, where they have no fielder in the ring, and they pick up a smart two
well done Karthik, left alone in a Twenty20 game, and it wasn't too wide also
short and wide again, and AB cuts it, despite being forward, and hits it to the right of point
Flintoff is back, and bowls a short and wide one, and Karthik gets a single to third man
dot ball, and again AB just ends up defending a topspinner, second time in this over
on the pads, and flicked away to the left of short fine and the right deep backward suare leg, easy two
flighted this time, and Karthik defends into the covers and takes off for one
just short of length, Karthik goes deep into the crease, picks the doosra, and cuts it to the right of the sweper-cover, what a shot, could well have been played in a Test
dances down the track, drops it straight towards midwicket,with sodft hands, and another single stolen
just outside off, thrown up, and AB just defends it, strange
good running again, AB chips down the track, sees no room to hit it, and drops it straight towards point, and the two run through immediately
short and just wide of off, and dabbed away towards thirdman
and a cheeky start for him, a bouncer tried, just outside off, and he upper-cuts it late, over Dhoni's head, smart little shot

out to a fulltoss, it's on the stumps, maybe leg, and Dilshan looks to make room, but can't get enough room to get the elevation to clear Suresh Raina at extra cover. Some might say a lucky wicket, but the pressure from previous two dot balls worked. At any rate, what a little gem from Dilshan
and a yorker to follow it up with, quick, seam-up, and Dilshan hits it straight into the ground and back to Morkel
Morkel comes back, and beats Dilshan right away with a slower delivery, he is into the shot way too early
thrown up again, and Dilshan gets to his fifty via a single into the covers. What an innings after two big wickets, early in the innings
and Dilshan gets back now, through a deft late-cut, this one was flatter and quicker, he opens the face late and beats Morkel at short third man
thrown up, on off stump, Dilshan looks for a big hit, and is beaten in the flight, and by the rip, lucky to not lob it
topspinner, AB didn't read it, but still manages a single to long-off
fuller on the pads, and a single to mid-on
flat, quick, on the pads, and flicked away for an easy two, good placement
short and wide, and cut away to sweeper-cover

what Misbah couldn't do, Dilshan does, he pre-medidates for a paddle Joginder, gets on a knee, to scoop a wide delivery outside off, over the short fine leg. this bounces just feet inside the boundary, what a shot
fuller, wide outside off, and the bat face opens for a single to third man
lovely delivery, short and wide, Dilshan thinks ah easy four runs, but this one cuts in sharply, and cramps him up, only a single
slower ball, just outside off, Dilshan looks to run it down, but is early and is beaten
AB looks to chip down, but this is an accurate delivery on the stumps, and AB bunts it down and hands the strike over to Dilshan
shortish, outside off, and AB dabs it towards thirdman
goes for a big heave, widish delivery, gets the outer half of the bat and a single to third man
there is no luck involved in this one, shorter, this is pur timing, shorter, Dilshan rocks back and swings it over square leg, one of the longer boundaries. He looks in top form
lucky Dilshan, looks to loft it over extra, a length ball, bounces and takes a thick edge overe the slip cordon
good ball again, short of length, and Dilshan looks to make room, but there is none, and this gets a bit big too
on target right away, just short of length, on off stump, and steered away to third man
three in a row, the best of the lot, full, on off, Dilshan clears the front leg, and drives it powerfully between mid-off and extra. Quick outfield, and Dilshan is enjoying it
wrong line, with fine leg in the circle, on the pads, and flicked away to the left of the fielder, that was easy
fulltoss, mistimed heave, beats midwicket, and deep square leg has no chance of stopping this
full, on the off stump, and Dilshan looks to drive through the off side, but can't beat the cover ring
superb running, full delivery played straiggt to mid-on, and they scramper through for one
and what a poor loosener, angling down the leg, and deflected away fine, very fine, just to left of Dhoni, and easy four
on the pads again, and flicked just to left of deep fline leg, and Dilshan and AB are exceptionally quick to get two from that shot
second six of the over, Gony errs in line this time, into the pads, just short of driving length, but Dilshan just flicks it, gets solid power into it, and clears square-leg boundary easily
accurate, length ball, Dilshan looks to clear his leg, but there is no room to hit through
a length ball, just outside off, a thickish edge but there is no slip, and an easy single to third man
boom, first six of the match, just short of driving length, he picked it early, and pulled it, despite his weight being on the fron foot, and it goes saling over midwicket
and a diving Raina saves four, full driving length, and AB drives it, but Raina is quick at cover
just short of driving length, Dilshan looks to crash it throuch covers, but can't beat Flintoff at short cover
full again, angling in, AB looks to drive and gets his pad too far ahead, but manages to get bat in front, and takes a quick single to mid-off
fullish, into the stumps this time, and AB plays it towards midwicket, where Parthiv is alert
fullish, just outside off, and holding its line, and Dilshan manages to place it between mid-ff and extra, for a single
this is full and wide, Dilshan reaches for it, and plays it with an open face, and gets enouigh elevation to clear the circle, not his cleanly, but four nonetheless
full, on the stumps, hit towards mid-off, and shouts "no" straight away

the was coming all along, Sehwag has not at all looked good today, and here he puiills a delivery that is too full, and he top-edges it this time, lobbing it to Morkel at mid-on. So the underdogs of this openeing battle, Bala and Gony, have struck once each. Sehwag and Gambhir gone
looks for pull, but the ball is too full, and he ends up playing it towards mid-off, not the best of starts for Sehwag so far
on the target, on the length, and AB drops it down into the on side, and rushes through for one
full again, and driven straight, and Bala makes a good diving save at mid-off, keeping him down to one
almost got him, is the pitch too slow for Sehwag's liking, he is early into the pull again, and almost carries to midwicket
gentle loosener, 124ks, drivable length, and Sehwag gives it the treatement, straight down for four
slightly fuller, but not drivable, Sehwag plays it towards mid-off, with soft hands, and rushes through for a single. What an over from Bala, what a start for Chennai
again short and wide, and Sehwag is early into the shot again, and ends up turning the bat face in his hand, and plays it back to Bala
short and wide, and Sehwag looks for another big one, but misses out again. Didn't look to cut it, he looked to go straight
short and sat up, and Sehwag looks to pull, but is beaten by the slowness of the ball
AB just bunts it down, and takes a single to cover

And Bala has struck first ball. It looked like a harmless leave. Gambhir walked a couple of steps down, and while shouldering arms he could have got en edge to it. Not clear from replays so far. It moved in a bit, and brushed the glove on the way. What a start for Chennai
short of a length, Murali goes for the big swing, and misses, the ball misses the stumps too, but Delhi have completeed a solid comeback
and it's all over for Chennai, Delhi have won it, a full delivery, Morkel looks to clear his leg and hit big, and the same story repeats, the inside half of the bat, and only a single to long-on

this is not smart from Bala, Morkel fails to hit a full and wide delivery, but Bala for some reason wants the single, Morkel doesn't. Sangwan from cover flicks it to the bowler, and Bala is at the strikers' end
Warner, the substitute, makes the difference again. Joginder hit a fullish delivery straight  to mid-off and ran, and gave up half-way through, and Warner hit the middle stump out of the ground
just short of a length, Joginder slaps it to wide of long-on, and they take two again. Surprising? Wouldn't they want Morkel on strike?
Joginder makes room, lofts it over extra cover, but they stroll only for two

and he has run himself out now, hit powerfully towards Sehwag at cover, who underarms it to Vettori, and Gony is slow and short of the crease. What a twist. The crucial second was lost in this run-out because of a near-collission between the batsmen
and Gony turns it around, Vettori had bowled so far this game, with this flighted delivery is clubbed from down on a knee, this could well be eight over midwicket boundary
lovely bowling again, Morkel looks to make room, Vettori follows with an arm-ball, getting just a leg-bye

a dot ball, and a wicket, Badri, who looked out of place through the innings, steps out, and hits a flat delivery straight to Warner, the substitute, at long-off. How Delhi have come back. Good move too, to keep Vettori for the death
nice arm-ball, quick, angled in, and Morkel just turns it around to square leg, it was more than 100ks
Badri steps out, full, on the target, no room for Badri, and only a single to long-off
low fulltoss, ends a superb over, only five singles, Badri can't capitalise on the fulltoss, just managing to get it past Nehra
another full, late-swinging delivery, and Morkel clears his front leg, and gets the inside half of his bat again, only a single to midwicket

lovely, in-swinging yorker, dot ball. Could have been much more, Morkel looks for a leg bye, but the ball has gone to Karthik, who tries to throw the stumps down, with the gloves on, and just misses. 26 off 14 now
Badri tries to get out, steps out, chips it limple, from the pads, and it falls just short of a running-in square leg
full, swinging in, Morkel looks for a big hit, and gets only the inside half of the bat, and a single to square leg
almost a yorker, Badri goes for the big hit, manages a mis-hit towards lonmg-off, for a single
and Badri goes thirdman again, just outside off, Badri waits for it and opens the face at the last moment. Only 5 off the over, makes it tighter, 29 off 18
another short ball, and he survives again, Morkel looks to cut it through covers, but finds Gambhir at extra cover
again short, on the stumps, Badri looks for a single to thirdman, but the face opens late, he still manages the one just off the wicket
another short delivery, Morkel is a touch late into the pull, and only just manages to clear AB at midwicket
short, sitting up for the pull, but Morkel mistimes, and plays it straight to midwicket. Dot Ball. That's big
short and wide, and steered away to thirdman
Nehra strikes. Flintoff goes. slower ball again, and Flintoff is early into this loft, chipping it to Warner at long-off, what a twist
slower ball, on the stumps, and Morkel can manage just a single to cover
superb timing, low fulltoss, almost a yorker, on the pads, it's just flicked away, but runs away to the sqaure-leg boundary
overpitched, Flintoff walks in, and gets too close to the length, the inside edge gets him one to short fine
bouncer, and Nehra gets a dot ball, Flintoff ducks in, and this is straight enough and low enough
full, stright, drilled down, and substitute Warner dives full length at long-off boundary, the pick-up and throw all in one motion, good substitute
slower ball, but it's too short and Flintoff gets a single to sweeper-cover. What a spell from Sangwan, 28 runs in four overs, for the wickets of Hayden, Raina and Patel
there is the boundary, through an edge, fulltoss, and Flintoff throws his bat at it, and gets an edge to fine of third man
that's unfortunate, Flintoff walked down again, Sangwan bowls a sharp bouncer, Flintoff ducks, and it's just down the leg side
yorker, swinging in, and Morkel does well to hit to wide of mid-off
Flintoff walks down the track, mildly, not like Hayden, and drives straight to long-off
short and wide, cut away, and Morkel finds the sweeper-cover, Gambhir

what a bowling change, and Sangwan's golden spell continues, Raina tries his trademark pull over midwicket, but this it a touch too full to try that, and he hets more elevation than distance, and AB judgest the catch to perfection at the wide long-on boundary
angled across Flintoff, it's full, and he wants to take the leather off, but plays one bounce to cover, ane because it's hit so hard, there isn't a run taken
fulltoss, outside off, and Nannes gets away with it, played straight to point
this is just short of a length, and Raina gets his customary one boundary of the over, transfers his weight back, and pulls it over midwicket. He is planning this chase perfectly
full, stright, Raina plays it from the crease, and plays straight to short cover
lovely yorker, Raina can't do anything with it, Delhi need more of those
full, into the pads, and turned away nicely into the leg side, beating short fine, and getting him easy two
thrown up again, superb bowling, and Flintoff looks for the big drive but is beaten outside off. The ball isn't turning much, but Vettori's changes of pace are working for him
slow, this is very slow, and Flintoff has to make all the power, and in doing that he can't place it
straighter ball, hits him in the pads, but an easy leg bye
and Tiwary over-runs this one in the deep, lofted towards long-on, and Tiwary makes a mess of it
slower, thrown up, Flintoff waits for this length delivery, and plays it with open face for a single to point
full, on the stumps, played with an angled bat, wide of long-on, and the placement gets him two
full, outside off, and drilled back to the left of Tiwary, and he gets one hand to it, but it's too hard for him to stop cleanly, and Flintoff gets an easy run
on the pads this time,a nd helped away for one
just short of a driving length, Raina gets down on a knee, lofts if with a stright bat, and just clears the long-off fieldsman, and Raina is in the middle of a gem
length delivery, stumps to stumps, only s single to long-off
full, almost a yorker, and Raina can only play it straight to long-off
and it's short, and into the pads, Flintoff misses out but gets a single
and again Raina takes the pressure off with a last-ball boundary, a lovely drive through extra cover, this is the third time he has got four off the last ball of a good over
flatter, and Flintoff gets off the mark with a mistimed cut
and he almost gets Flintoff with an arm ball, Flintoff gets a big stride, plays for the turn, ir rapped on by the straighter delivery, and Taufel says no maybe because of the huge stride

and Vettori strikes, this is quicker and flatter, Dhoni looks to force it through the off side, gets an edge, Karthik, wearing the baseball mask he got from Peter McGlashan, juggles it but catches the rebound. Delhi are back through the old wizard
slow, really slow, 78ks, and Raina has to wait forever for the pull, and can only get a single to long-on
just short of length, outside off, Dhoni reaches out and defends it into the off side for a single
twice in a row, Raina hits four off the last ball of an over, this was short and wide, Raina hit it in the air deliberately, and hit it square of thirdman too
slower ball again, 109ks, Dhoni is early, but recovers well, and takes a single to long-off
yorker and they steal a single to point
slower ball, hit straight back, catchable high, but too far from Sangwan, and is placed well between long-off and long-on
charges down this time, and turns it off his pads
full, angling across, Dhoni looks for a drive, but can't beat short cover
just a bit short, and Raina rocks back and pulls it over midwicket for four, puts the pressure back. Interesting contest between Raina and Vettori now
and he throws it up again, slower in the air, and Raina ends defending a topspinner
nudged away into the leg side for another single
chipped over the bowler's head for a single
slow, thrown up, toppie, and Raina is beaten, bounces after hitting the thigh, and almost speeds off onto the middle stump, but the bail doesn't come off. Bizarre
steps down first ball, and bunts it into the leg side for a single

and the extra ball because of the no-ball gets Sangwan the big wicket of Hayden, what a big moment, this was short but maybe not short enough for the pull, and Hayden top-edges it for a simple catch for Nannes running in from long-on
looks to heave it, gets inside edge, and takes a single to midwicket
and Raina misses out on the free hit, even edges it to Karthik, no appeals, no excitement
free hit, could be the first of the tournament, as Raina is beaten as he tries to run it down to third man
full, outside off, and pummelled straight down to long-off for a single
misses out on that, saw the slower ball, waited for it as it angled into the pads, but couldn't beat the short fine
and Hayden walks down again, but gets the toe of the bat, but this one lobs straight down the ground for a two
looks to make room, Salvi follows him, and yorks him too, but Hayden still gets a single to long-off, 24 off this over
and Hayden gets to fifty with a smart scoop-sweep, this one was slower, he waited for it, and lofted it over short fine
Poor bowling from supposedly the McGrath clone, half-volley outside leg, would have been wide had Hayden not picked it up over short fine and taken an easy six
and Raina does his job well, takes an easy single into the on side
same shot again, but closes the face too early, and doesn't get the elevation, but this falss just short of long-on
is he ending Salvi's IPL here, walks out of the crease again, with karthik having gone back, and hits it cleanly over long-on
wide outside leg, and Hayden misses out on the scoop. Just as well for Chennai, as this beats poor Karthik, up to the stumps, and goes for five
straight ball, holds its line, and played for one with an open face
short of a length, on the stumps, Raina backs away and heaves, and gets the inside half of the bat to fine leg
shorter and straighter, and Raina arches back, makes room, and dabs it to third man
just short of a length, outside off, played with open face, no hurry to get off the mark

drilled straight up AB's throat, this was a wide half-volley, should have been hit. Hit it was, but straight to AB at covers, and despite the pace behind the ball, it was a fairly easy catch for a fielder of AB's standard
full and straight, and Parthiv has no room to do anything fancy with this one
and stars off with a wide outside off
full, on stumps, and drilled down the ground for two
full, on stumps, dropped at his toes, and a quick single
fuller, on the pads, and flicked away for one
see you later, Salvi ambled in in his run, Hayden walked towards him as he ran, he met the ball midway down the pitch, and picked it up for a huge six over midwicket
again, short and angling across, Parthiv upper-cuts again, and this one falls just short of thirdman
short ,angling across, Hayden looks to cut, but not enough room, he still manages a single and retrieves the orange cap
slower ball, driven away correctly, he leans into it, and off-drives it to left of mid-off, what a start Chennai have had. It's game on
on the pads this time, and he turns it away towards deep square
and Hayden walks down again, and what would have been a yorker becomes a low fulltoss, and it is four straight down the ground
almost bowled him, yorker, almost squeezed in through the big backlift, but Hayden managed to get the toe of his bat in the way
full, on the pads, and turned away towards deep backward square
these thigh pads are superb, he walks across too much, misses, and gets four leg byes off the thigh pads, it made him run karthik all the way and dive in vain
length ball, on the stumps, and turned away into the leg side for a single
a limp pull this time, this short one got a bit big on him and cramped him, and all he could manage was a top-edge that fell short of a running-in deep backward sqaure leg
Hayden goes for extra cover this time, doesn't connect properly, but is choosing his areas well, and gets two
Hayden walks down again, and slaps this length delivery for four through the gap between mid-on and midwicket
yorker, spot on, and Parthiv digs it out, and runs a single just to left of keeper
that was sharp, short and straight, Parthiv looks for an upper-cut but misses
what a lovely slower delivery, Hayden is walking down, and he loses sight of this 99ks</I delivery, and only sees it after it has hit between thighs
length ball, on the pads, and turned away towards square leg for a single
way down the leg side, no swing there
full, on the pads, Hayden is too early into the flick, this swings a bit, gets leading edge, but falls safely
a flick-chip, into the pads, and he clears the mid-on easily, deliberate shot, and a good result
a hint of swing, there, parthiv opens the face, plays into the coverswhere Tiwary and AB both let the ball go, but doesn't cost them an extra run
and first ball he has been swivel-pulled by Parthiv, short, into the body, and smashed away
there is no edge about this, short of length, angling in, Hayden is on front foot, lets the ball come on and turns it over square leg, less effort, more timing
edges working for Hayden, full ball, stands tall, swings almightily, thick inside edge and fine of fine leg
big swing again, and misses completely

whoa! Hayden walks down first ball, goes hard at it, slices it, and what an effort from AB. He runs back a long way, dives as he runs back, and gets his hands to it, pity he dropped it, it was that kind of an effort
similar length, just outside off, and defended with an open face, and they runs through for a quick single
on the target, length delivery, defended back to the bowler
